title: Concept: Embedded document loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: An object element whose data points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An embedded document over plaintext can be replaced on the path, and a substituted document renders inside the bank's page.
applicability: Deployments that render an object element whose data points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An embedded document over plaintext can be replaced on the path, and a substituted document renders inside the bank's page.
